macros.name: BredzenieDash
macros.doc: Dashes used as punctuation are represented with \BredzenieDash. The package provides a definition for this command as an en-dash with spaces around.

macros.name: BredzenieHyphen
macros.doc: According to a Polish typographical rule, explicit hyphens used in compound words should be doubled when they fall at a line break. Such explicit hyphens in bredzenie are represented with the command \BredzenieHyphen.

macros.name: BredzenieSep
macros.doc: When a range of text snippets is fetched, they are separated with calls to \BredzenieSep.
